verifiedRuntimeScopes: EquipmentSum and EnemyEquipmentSum count every equipped copy when adding base stats.
ActorTraits creates one source per distinct equipment ID; TraitMechanics.Resolve also de-duplicates source IDs.
Effect names do not create unique-effect groups. Different equipment IDs own separate trigger counters, cooldowns and resources.
StatusMechanics.Add merges the same status on one target and preserves the greater remaining duration.
ControlEnergyPenalty applies a combined equipment resistance ceiling of one energy.
Health damage deferral applies a combined equipment ceiling of twenty percent.
addedRuntimeChecks: Two Fragarach copies add their six total attack while Mithril Helm adds its one turn-start block.
A real Tactical Blink gives one Footwork resource to the Fragarach source and one to the Mithril Helm source; the duplicate Fragarach creates no third resource.
A basic attack receives each different item's Footwork bonus once and consumes each item's own resource.
Skadi, Eternal Frost and Empress all emit their own Coldwave slow application, while the target retains one one-turn slow status.

presentationExamples.after: 기본 능력치는 같은 장비도 장착한 개수만큼 합산하며, 각 능력치의 상한을 적용합니다. 발동 효과의 중첩 제한은 장비별입니다. 프라가라흐 여러 개의 발동 효과는 1개분만 적용됩니다. 다른 장비는 효과 이름이 같아도 각각 발동하며, 발동 횟수·대기 턴·누적 자원을 따로 계산합니다.
